/* USE : CdMapper.getNmcodeGrpCdList */
SELECT NMCODE_GRP_CD , NMCODE_CD , NMCODE_NM , NMCODE_ITEM_1 , NMCODE_ITEM_2 , USE_COL_NM , USE_TARGET_FG , USE_SYSTEM_FG , REG_DT , REG_ID , MOD_DT , MOD_ID FROM TB_CM_NMCODE WHERE NMCODE_GRP_CD = '999' AND NMCODE_ITEM_1 IN ('C', 'H') AND NMCODE_CD NOT IN (SELECT NMCODE_CD FROM TB_CM_NMCODE_MOMS_V02 WHERE HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} ) -- 맘스터치 본사 미사용 공통코드
AND NMCODE_CD LIKE '%'||#{nmcodeCd}||'%'
AND NMCODE_NM LIKE '%'||#{nmcodeNm}||'%'
AND USE_YN = #{useYn}
ORDER BY NMCODE_GRP_CD, NMCODE_CD
SELECT NMCODE_GRP_CD , NMCODE_CD , NMCODE_NM , NMCODE_ITEM_1 , NMCODE_ITEM_2 , USE_COL_NM , USE_TARGET_FG , USE_SYSTEM_FG , REG_DT , REG_ID , MOD_DT , MOD_ID FROM TB_CM_NMCODE WHERE NMCODE_GRP_CD = '999' AND NMCODE_ITEM_1 IN ('C', 'S') AND NMCODE_CD NOT IN (SELECT NMCODE_CD FROM TB_CM_NMCODE_MOMS_V03 WHERE STORE_CD = #{storeCd} ) -- 맘스터치 매장 미사용 공통코드
AND NMCODE_CD LIKE '%'||#{nmcodeCd}||'%'
AND NMCODE_NM LIKE '%'||#{nmcodeNm}||'%'
AND USE_YN = #{useYn}
ORDER BY NMCODE_GRP_CD, NMCODE_CD

/* USE : CdMapper.getCdStoreAllowGrpList */ SELECT NMCODE_CD , NMCODE_NM FROM TB_CM_NMCODE WHERE NMCODE_GRP_CD = '999' AND NMCODE_ITEM_1 = 'C' -- C:공통(본사기준, 단독매장수정가능) AND NMCODE_CD NOT IN (SELECT NMCODE_CD FROM TB_CM_NMCODE_MOMS_V02 WHERE HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} ) -- 본사 미사용 공통코드 제외 ORDER BY NMCODE_CD

/* USE : CdMapper.getCdStoreAllowList */ SELECT tms.STORE_CD , tms.STORE_NM , thn.NMCODE_CD , CASE WHEN INSTR(NVL(thn.NMCODE_ITEM_2, ' '), 'I') > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS I_YN , CASE WHEN INSTR(NVL(thn.NMCODE_ITEM_2, ' '), 'U') > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS U_YN , CASE WHEN INSTR(NVL(thn.NMCODE_ITEM_2, ' '), 'D') > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS D_YN FROM TB_MS_STORE tms LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_HQ_NMCODE thn ON thn.HQ_OFFICE_CD = tms.HQ_OFFICE_CD AND thn.NMCODE_GRP_CD = '251' AND thn.NMCODE_NM = #{nmcodeNm} AND thn.NMCODE_ITEM_1 = tms.STORE_CD WHERE tms.HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} ORDER BY tms.STORE_CD
